pause_zone.name: Pause zone
pause_zone.description: Add or update a reason that pauses automatic schedule execution for one managed climate entity. The climate can optionally be turned off while any reason remains.

until_next_block.name: Until next block
until_next_block.description: End this pause at the next scheduled block start. Expiry is fixed when requested and does not follow later schedule edits. Cannot be combined with duration_minutes. Fails if no future block exists; other pause reasons remain active.

start_planned_return.name: I'm leaving
start_planned_return.description: Plan a one-off return for a future date and time using saved Modes and Automatic scheduling. With configured occupancy sources, waits for confirmed absence unless Apply Away mode now is enabled; without sources, activates Away immediately. Works with the weekly routine disabled and updates an active absence.

return_date.name: Return date
return_date.description: Arrival date in Home Assistant's time zone. The date and time together must be in the future.

return_time.name: Return time
return_time.description: Arrival time on the selected date in Home Assistant's time zone. Use HH:MM in YAML; optional seconds must be 00. Nonexistent daylight saving times are rejected.

apply_away_now.name: Apply Away mode now
apply_away_now.description: Apply the configured Away mode immediately. With occupancy sources, automatic presence return is enabled only after continuous absence for the configured confirmation delay. Scheduled preparation and arrival remain active.

cancel_planned_return.name: Cancel planned return
cancel_planned_return.description: Cancels a planned return or closes an inactive return notice. After Away was applied, including immediate manual Away before monitored departure confirmation, restores the Mode and Profiles selected before the episode started. A normal pending departure leaves selection unchanged. Stops automatic return for this absence. You can explicitly plan a new return afterward.

update_block_preset.name: Update Velair preset
update_block_preset.description: Persistently update an existing shared preset and reconcile its schedules. Omitted values are preserved in update mode.

preset_key.name: Velair preset identifier
preset_key.description: Stable identifier copied from the preset editor. Changes affect all references.

temperature.name: Target temperature
temperature.description: Single target in the Velair temperature unit. Omit to preserve it.

target_temp_low.name: Lower target temperature
target_temp_low.description: Send both range limits. A range replaces the single target.

target_temp_high.name: Upper target temperature
target_temp_high.description: Send both range limits. A range replaces the single target.

temperature_only.name: Temperature only
temperature_only.description: Update targets without requesting an HVAC mode change or turn-on. Requires a temperature action without device options. Use clear_fields or replace to remove an existing HVAC mode or options.

hvac_mode.name: HVAC mode
hvac_mode.description: Omit to preserve the mode. For an Off-only action, use replace with action turn_off.

preset_mode.name: Device preset
preset_mode.description: Device preset mode, distinct from the shared Velair preset.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: update preserves omitted fields and action. replace removes omitted fields and requires action.

action.name: Replacement action
action.description: Only for replace. Select the complete resulting action.

clear_fields.name: Remove settings
clear_fields.description: Only for update. Remove settings without resetting the device. The result must remain valid.

copy_day_schedule.name: Clone day schedule
copy_day_schedule.description: Clone a saved weekday to target days and managed climates, preserving template links and Velair preset references.

entity_id.name: Source climate
entity_id.description: Managed climate whose saved day will be cloned.

source_weekday.name: Source weekday
source_weekday.description: Saved day to clone, including its template link and preset references.

target_weekdays.name: Target weekdays
target_weekdays.description: Replace these saved days in every selected target climate. Other days are unchanged.

target_entity_ids.name: Target climates
target_entity_ids.description: Omit to clone within the source climate. All destinations are validated and saved together.

expected_revision.name: Configuration revision
expected_revision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency check. Omit to clone the latest saved source under the configuration lock.

activate_profile.name: Activate climate profile
activate_profile.description: Set one saved climate profile as the complete base and clear all zone exceptions. Zones not covered by it use their default schedules. Leave the profile ID empty to return every zone to Default.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Stable key of the profile to activate. Empty clears the active set and selects Default.

deactivate_profile.name: Deactivate climate profile
deactivate_profile.description: Return every zone to Default by clearing the base profiles and all zone exceptions.

activate_profiles.name: Activate climate profiles as base
activate_profiles.description: Replace the complete base with non-overlapping profiles and clear all zone exceptions. An empty list selects Default. Profile selection does not guarantee simultaneous physical delivery.

profile_ids.name: Profile IDs
profile_ids.description: Ordered list of stable Profile IDs. Profiles must not include the same zone.

apply_profiles.name: Apply climate profiles as exceptions
apply_profiles.description: Replace exceptions only in the zones explicitly included by these profiles. Other zones keep their selection. Overlapping profiles in this request reject the whole action; an empty list does nothing. Cancels a pending Return home.

profile_ids.name: Profile IDs
profile_ids.description: List of stable Profile IDs whose explicit zones should use these profiles as exceptions.

set_zone_profile.name: Set zone profile exception
set_zone_profile.description: Apply only one zone from a saved profile, preserving every other zone selection. The profile must include this zone. Use YAML null for Default; use Clear profile exceptions to inherit the base. Cancels a pending Return home.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Stable Profile ID, or YAML null to explicitly use the zone's Default schedule.

clear_profile_overrides.name: Clear profile exceptions
clear_profile_overrides.description: Restore the current base for the explicitly selected zones. Previous exceptions are not restored. An empty list does nothing. Cancels a pending Return home when zones are requested.

entity_id.name: Climate entities
entity_id.description: One managed climate entity or a list. All targets must be valid before any exception is removed.
